page_title: CAG 1-2 COM | Cagliari v Como 07/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+6' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
90+5' Sergi Roberto (Como) makes a strong challenge and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
90+4' Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball. It's a free kick to Como in a dangerous position.
90+4' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Livio Marinelli ignores the protests.
89' The game is interrupted as Yael Trepy (Cagliari) is flagged offside.
88' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
88' Riyad Idrissi is substituted due to injury. Fabio Pisacane gives a chance to Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari).
87' The game is interrupted now, Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

86' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it! Cagliari force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' Livio Marinelli shows a yellow card to Jacobo Ramon (Como), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
83' Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari) makes a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. Como have a free kick.
82' Yael Trepy (Cagliari) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
81' Cesc Fabregas has decided to make a change. Sergi Roberto (Como) replaces Martin Baturina.
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alex Valle (Como) comes onto the pitch so that Alberto Moreno can be given a rest.
80' That will be all from Nico Paz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Diego Carlos (Como).
78' Substitution. Riyad Idrissi (Cagliari) replaces Juan Rodriguez.
78' Fabio Pisacane decides to make a substitution. Joseph Liteta will be replaced by Semih Kilicsoy (Cagliari).
78' Here comes a substitution. Sebastiano Esposito is given a rest as he is replaced by Yael Trepy (Cagliari).

76' 1 - 2 Goal! Ignace Van der Brempt puts Lucas Da Cunha (Como) in the clear with just the keeper to beat. He takes his shot early from the edge of the box and scores beautifully into the top left corner. 1:2.
75' Alvaro Morata (Como) sends a cross into the box, but Elia Caprile comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Como will take a free kick.
73' Substitution. Jose Pedro did his best and is replaced by Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari).
72' The corner is swung in but Como can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
72' Alvaro Morata (Como) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Como have been awarded a corner kick.
71' The referee gives a yellow card to Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari).
70' An attempted cross from Mergim Vojvoda (Como) is cleared.
69' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
69' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
67' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul after Mergim Vojvoda (Como) hacks down one of his opponents. Cagliari win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) is yellow-carded.
65' Como take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
64' Alvaro Morata (Como) gets on the end of a good cross and shoots, but his attempt is inadvertently blocked by one of his own teammates. The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
63' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Livio Marinelli saw the whole situation. A free kick to Como.
62' Cesc Fabregas has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alvaro Morata (Como) replacing Anastasios Douvikas.
62' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) serves up a nice cross, but Elia Caprile punches the ball away.
61' Nico Paz (Como) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
61' Mergim Vojvoda (Como) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Como can continue in their attacking effort.
59' Nico Paz (Como) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.

56' 1 - 1 Adam Obert showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 1:1.
53' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) commits a rough challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Cagliari.
52' Martin Baturina (Como) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
51' Jesus Rodriguez (Como) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
51' Anastasios Douvikas (Como) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
49' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jean Butez intercepts the ball.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+4' Marc Oliver Kempf (Como) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Cagliari.
45+3' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Como.

45+2' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Como, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Alberto Moreno (Como) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Cagliari are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

43' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Livio Marinelli with no other option than to blow for a foul. Cagliari will take a free kick near the side line.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) was too aggressive in his challenge. Como earn a free kick.
39' Good movement by Jesus Rodriguez (Como), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
38' Adam Obert (Cagliari) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
38' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
37' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
37' Ignace Van der Brempt (Como) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
36' Cesc Fabregas is forced to make a change. Maximo Perrone is unable to continue due to injury, Mergim Vojvoda (Como) comes on.
33' Maximo Perrone (Como) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
33' Maximo Perrone (Como) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
32' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) is caught offside!
32' Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
30' Livio Marinelli blows for a foul after Adam Obert (Cagliari) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Como are awarded the free kick.
30' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
30' Maximo Perrone (Como) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
29' Maximo Perrone (Como) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cagliari was in an offside position.
27' Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
26' Livio Marinelli couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Maximo Perrone (Como) and blew his whistle. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
25' Dangerous play by Anastasios Douvikas (Como). Livio Marinelli blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Cagliari.
25' Flag up against Anastasios Douvikas (Como). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
24' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) tackles a bit over-zealously and Livio Marinelli blows for a foul. Free kick. Como will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
23' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
23' Lucas Da Cunha (Como) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
22' Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
21' Jacobo Ramon (Como) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
19' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) picks up the rebound after chaos in the box and directs a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper, however, denies him with a stunning save.
18' Adam Obert (Cagliari) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
18' One of the Como players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. Cagliari have a free kick.
17' Alberto Moreno (Como) was too forceful with his tackle and Livio Marinelli interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Cagliari have a free kick.
14' Martin Baturina (Como) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the bottom left corner.
13' One of the players from Cagliari times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
12' Livio Marinelli blows his whistle. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) commits a foul after dangerous play. That's a free kick to Cagliari.
11' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Cagliari was in an offside position.

7' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Como.
7' Rough tackle by Jesus Rodriguez (Como). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari get a free kick.
6' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Cagliari, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

6' A player from Como commits a rough challenge. Livio Marinelli blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Cagliari, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
6' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jean Butez, who smothers the ball.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nico Paz (Como) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' Cagliari are ruled offside.
3' Maximo Perrone (Como) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
2' Como are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Como will have the kick-off.
Livio Marinelli will supervise the game today.
